integrity: Same-model scientific review only. Full extension-field arithmetic and orbit enumeration are reproducible from the accompanying source code; no independent certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only smooth 2-bic cubic threefolds defined over F2; the 165-point geometric Eckardt locus and the thirteen base-field congruence classes are known. The contribution is the exact Frobenius splitting cycle census of that locus. Equivalent classical tables may exist.
title: Ten Frobenius splitting types of the 165 Eckardt points on binary Frobenius cubic threefolds
